make_dataset_by_id: create a dataset instance by calling make_dataset with a dataset ID string and keyword arguments
register_objectnav_dataset: run the object navigation dataset registration by importing the registration module to auto-register ObjectNavDatasetV1
register_pointnav_dataset: run the point navigation dataset registration by importing the registration module to auto-register PointNavDatasetV1
register_vln_dataset: run the visual language navigation dataset registration by importing the registration module to auto-register R2R VLN dataset
register_rearrange_dataset: run the rearrange dataset registration by importing the registration module to auto-register RearrangeDatasetV0
